column1: # FST4 golden harness manifest — one line per demo:

# command (5th column onward, optional): full command line to run instead of
#   ./<name> — used for fst4 CLI scenarios. Scenario commands use
#   --stable-output (strips timings) and --verbosity silent (suppresses
#   library progress prose) so output is byte-stable; tier column must be
#   present ("-" for fast) when a command is given.
# modes:
#   exact  — normalized full output must byte-match the golden (<baseline dir>/<name>.out)
#   result — only the final result signature must match (<baseline dir>/<name>.result);
#            used where full output is not run-stable (thread interleaving)
#   smoke  — no golden: demo must exit 0 within the timeout and print at least one
#            "Criterion value" line; used for wall-clock-budgeted (load-dependent) demos
#   skip   — not run by the harness; reason in trailing comment
# tier (4th column, optional): "slow" = excluded from the default check/capture run;
#   include with FST_GOLDEN_SLOW=1 or by naming the demo explicitly. Run the slow tier
#   at least before every release (see tests/README.md, which also explains the per-platform
#   baseline directories tests/golden-<platform>/).
# Timeouts are ~3x observed runtime, sized to the slowest machine in regular use
# (see tests/README.md "Portability"); a timeout is a FAILURE.
